name: writing-honest-claims
title_zh: 证据撑到哪句，结论就写到哪句的措辞阶梯
tagline_zh: 跑完分析最怕写结论：明明只是相关性，落笔就成了「导致」。它把结论分三级——观察到的、有方向的、能支撑决策的。
tagline_en: The scariest part of analysis is the write-up: a correlation becomes 'causes' the moment you type it. This splits.
desc_en: Writes findings in language the evidence can carry — the claim ladder (observed → directional → decision-support, never causal without a design), effect sizes over drama, banned phrasings. Use when writing any conclusion, report section, playbook, or public page from analysis results.
why_zh: 它不润色，它降级。按证据强度决定你能用哪个动词，效应量优先于戏剧性，越界的句子直接被打回。
why_en: It doesn't polish, it downgrades. The evidence tier picks your verb, effect sizes beat drama, and any sentence reaching past its.
limit_zh: 只管措辞不管统计：它不会告诉你样本量够不够、置信区间怎么算，也不判断你的分析本身对不对。
limit_en: Wording only, not statistics: it won't check sample size, CIs, or whether your analysis is right. Covers conclusion paragraphs in EN/ZH, not chart.
title_en: A claim ladder that stops your wording where the evidence.
